blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — Malacañang on Wednesday said President Ferdinand Marcos Jr. was “seriously considering” granting an absolute pardon to Mary Jane Veloso, the Filipino woman who came close to being executed in Indonesia for a drug trafficking conviction but was later allowed to be moved to a Philippine prison to serve the rest of her commuted sentence. Asked during a briefing at the Palace whether Veloso could be released on humanitarian grounds in time for Christmas, Palace press officer Claire Castro replied that it would depend on Marcos. “Should I preempt the president?
